name: Goblet Squat

instructions.description: Hold one dumbbell close to the chest with both hands.
Stand with feet in a comfortable stance and brace the trunk gently.
Bend the hips and knees together, keeping the weight close to the body.
Pause at a comfortable depth, then stand smoothly while exhaling.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the external load used without treating it as a universal target.

variations.variationDescription: Bodyweight Squat provides a meaningfully different loading, support, or stability option compared with Goblet Squat.
Goblet Squat — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Goblet Squat — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Choose a load that allows controlled movement.
